question: Which two actions are needed to configure a single Cisco APIC controller for Cisco ACI fabric for the first time? (Choose two.)
options: Register all leaf and spine switches.
Register the APIC that is connected to the switch.
Register the switches that are discovered through LLDP.
Configure the first Cisco APIC controller.
Configure the leaf switch where the Cisco APIC is connected, using CLI to allow APIC connectivity.
theory: Bringing up a brand-new ACI fabric starts with configuring the very first APIC controller through its console setup script (fabric name, infra VLAN, TEP pool, and so on); that APIC then uses LLDP to automatically discover directly connected leaf switches, and any switches those leaves in turn discover. The administrator registers those LLDP-discovered switches through the APIC GUI or CLI, rather than manually registering every leaf and spine upfront or configuring the leaf switch's own CLI, since ACI's switch discovery and registration process is fundamentally driven by LLDP originating from the first configured APIC. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 4 — ACI Fabric Bring-Up: Bootstrap and Switch Discovery)
